entities.summary: Michael Robert Leighton Blair is a Scottish rugby union coach and former professional player. He is currently assistant coach of the Kobe Steelers and attack coach for the New Zealand national team. He was previously the head coach of Edinburgh, and was an assistant coach with Glasgow Warriors and then an assistant coach of the Scotland national team.
